iteration_history.name: probabilistic_prompt_rewrite
iteration_history.key_change: Complete prompt rewrite: exhaustion awareness, session dynamics, EMA alignment, removed A/B/C/D patterns, removed all mechanical filters. FAILED: 27% WR — prompt teaching doesn't change model behavior, conviction inverted (HIGH=27%, LOW=40%), skipped 75% WR trades, TREND+DOWNTREND SHORT still 0/5.

iteration_history.name: enriched_iter26
iteration_history.key_change: Iter26 base + Pattern E (exhaustion trap), EMA alignment, swing magnitude, session caution. Model labeled Edge E on 3/4 TREND+DT trades but still output BEARISH. LONG degraded 58%→0%. Prompt enrichment confirmed to be a dead end.

iteration_history.name: two_agent_architecture
iteration_history.key_change: Two-agent: Market Reader + Trade Executor. 70t definitive batch: 40% WR, +0.00R, 86% exec rate. Reader alignment bug + executor pattern binding issues identified. See ITER30_PLAN.md.

iteration_history.name: reader_fixes_filter_c
iteration_history.key_change: Run 2: 57.7% WR, +11.50R (26 exec, 4 skip, 30t) — best since Iter26. Reader alignment fix, regime respect, executor pattern binding, position awareness, swing guard, Filter C. RSI tested in Runs 3-4: no predictive value on 5m/14-period (83% neutral, 0/18 losses warned), reverted.

key_features: Two-agent: Market Reader (pure analysis) + Trade Executor (decision)
Pre-computed EMA_VS_STRUCTURE and swingCombo fields for both agents
Edge patterns A/B/C/D with binding rule (pattern dictates direction)
Position awareness + swing structure guard in executor
Mechanical Filter A: no SHORT below support (pos < 0%)
Mechanical Filter B: no SHORT into higher highs (HH diff > 1 pip)
Mechanical Filter C: no SHORT in TREND+DOWNTREND (mechanical mismatch)
Previous day high/low for false break detection
Mechanical levels: SL=1.2xATR_30m, TP=1.5:1 R:R, Risk=0.50
simulator_changes: Enters at next bar open (market price)
Adjusts SL/TP to preserve original R:R
